name: secret-shield
description: Keeps secrets out of Claude's context: API keys, tokens, private keys and passwords in tool output are replaced with [REDACTED:kind] before the model or the transcript ever sees them.

blockSecretFiles.title: Block secret files
blockSecretFiles.description: Also refuse Read, Edit and Write on files that usually hold secrets (.env, *.pem, id_rsa, ~/.aws/credentials, .npmrc...). .env.example and friends stay readable.

redactPrompts.title: Redact prompts
redactPrompts.description: Also redact secrets you paste into your own prompts. Off by default, since a pasted key is usually meant for Claude.
